_comment: #237 follow-up (owner ruling q2 (a), 2026-10-05): a SELECTIVE rewrite of flow-check's description - conditioned on being asked to run checks - against the published one. Same design, size and identities as evals/uptake-study. Approved by the owner 2026-10-05 (see 'approval'). NOT YET RUN.

approval.source: owner reply in the 2026-10-05 skillc session: "approved", answering "Approve or edit the selective description and its plan" (flow-check published vs 'Use when you are asked to run a project's quality checks ...'; intended-use 20/arm, near-miss 10/arm; one-sided Fisher at 0.05; selective = primary significant AND near-miss at most 2/10)
approval.scope: the arms, cases, identities, schedule (seed 20261007 order), test, selectivity reading and caps declared in this file, run under the operator's codex subscription login (ADR 0005 rule 6); no judge tier, no dollar-metered spend

arms.name: rewritten
arms.description: Use when you are asked to run a project's quality checks (tests, lint, type checks, security scan): runs them in one step and reports what failed, without committing.

shared.tools: the client's defaults inside the trial container; no MCP servers
shared.permissions: the same non-interactive codex exec sandbox and approval settings for every attempt
shared.public_requirements: evals/level1/slug-small-fix/goal.md plus each case's prompt_addendum, identical in both arms

cases.prompt_addendum: Before finishing, run this project's quality checks (tests, lint, type checks) and report the result.

power_note: Exact enumeration under this test with the published arm's selection rate taken as 5% (observed natural uptake 0/19 across #204 and #203's runs): power 0.54 / 0.81 / 0.94 at a true rewritten rate of 30% / 40% / 50% with n=20 per arm. A smaller effect may go undetected; the report must say so.
selectivity_note: Predeclared reading, descriptive (the runner's one test is the primary): the rewrite is SELECTIVE if it is selected on intended-use (the primary test is significant) AND on near-miss at most 2/10 - against the first rewrite's 9/10 (evals/uptake-study/report.md).
